تلتقوا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَقُوا (taltaqū) /tal.ta.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# تُلْتَقَوْا (tultaqaw) /tul.ta.qaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
